about: VI-15: red-team cases for the AI interviewer's turns. Each case is the candidate's latest reply (and, optionally, earlier exchanges). expect lists the outcomes that pass: language and topic (she brings them back), clarify (she explains the question), follow_up (a normal follow-up), move_on (she moves to the next question). mustNot lists patterns her line must never match. Add a case here first whenever a new bad behaviour is reported, then fix the prompt until it passes.

RAG is retrieval augmented generation. We split documents into chunks, embed them, retrieve the most similar chunks for a question and add them to the prompt, so the model answers from our data.
Basically yaar, RAG means we fetch the relevant chunks from a vector database and give them to the LLM along with the question, na. That way it answers from our documents.
